title: Human Biological Need and Resource Network Contract v2
description: A species/population-scale human need taxonomy spanning material, reproductive, neural, social and emergent spiritual regulation. Individuals are observation/carrier units, not unique network roots.

population_scope.description: Biological scale at which the need is aggregated: organism population, reproductive population, social group or intergenerational population.

need_nature.description: Material, reproductive, psychological, social or emergent spiritual regulation; categories may overlap.

biological_basis.description: Candidate biological/social mechanism. It is a model field until independently sourced.

deprivation_response.description: Candidate functional consequence of persistent deprivation; not a diagnosis or numerical effect.

cultural_variability.description: How strongly observable satisfaction forms may vary across culture and institutions.

event_time.description: When the model decision or real-world event occurred.

available_time.description: Earliest time the row is available to the local model.

observation_time.description: When a resource or population state was measured.

accepted_model_structure.description: Accepted taxonomy structure, not a claim that every mechanism or deprivation effect is empirically verified.

candidate_needs_evidence.description: Candidate dependency only; cannot be used as a verified fact.

not_yet_observed.description: Missing quantity or accessibility is unknown, never zero.

carrier_mapping.description: Individuals, groups, companies and securities can be observation or process carriers but cannot create root needs.
